baseline_preservation.limitation: The original registration stores initial counts and exact old hold/meta/legacy authorization and quarantined audit fingerprints, but not a full pre-run snapshot of all 248 settled rows. Their count is retained and exactly 48 new registered rows exist. The after-first-run SQLite backup supports later replication comparisons; it cannot prove byte equality of every old settled row across this first run.

provider_cost_boundary.statement: Every new transport returned HTTP 200 and a verified supported model; token-derived estimates settle exactly. The current public quote is not an account invoice or evidence resolving either old unknown outcome. Both old holds remain counted against the cap.
